Zephyrus.definition: Zephyrus ī, m, *ze/furos, a gentle west wind, western breeze, zephyr, V., H., O.—Person., V.

zelotypus.definition: zēlotypus adj., zhlo/tupos, jealous: Iarba, Iu.: moechae, Iu.

zodiacus.definition: zōdiacus ī, m, zwdiako/s, the zodiac.

zona.definition: zōna ae, f, zw/nh, a woman's girdle, belt, zone: Persephones, O.: teres, O.—A money-belt, H.—Of the constellation Orion, the Belt, O.—Of the earth, a climatic region, zone: Quinque tenen<*> caelum zonae, V., O.

zonarius.definition: zōnārius adj. zona, of a belt, of a girdle; hence, plur m. as subst, makers of girdles.
